learning_question: What timing + selection experiment cues follow from closed episodes and existing observe instruments without sealing N205 or applying knobs?

timing_cues.claim: N200 entry lever win; exit lever lose
timing_cues.why_matters: Per-lever fair-cost verdicts are independent of path P&L — exit lose + entry win is a factory timing signal, not a book rewrite
timing_cues.falsify_or_promote: Volume gate met + thicker closed cohort; promote only via sealed observe design (F8), never mid-flight knob apply

timing_cues.claim: buy_tier_level exit-timing not ready for probability analysis
timing_cues.why_matters: Live hold/swap probability stays parked until closed cohorts mature
timing_cues.falsify_or_promote: ready_for_probability_analysis true with hold+swap closed targets; else keep collecting (L117/N25)

timing_cues.claim: Control exit-shadow closed=0 open=29 (auto-tune still gated)
timing_cues.why_matters: Post-exit path answers 'too early?' only after closed shadows thicken
timing_cues.falsify_or_promote: N25: ≥15 closed exits/track before exit-shadow→knob path

timing_cues.why_matters: Offline priors exist for experiment design when live swap closed=0
timing_cues.falsify_or_promote: L121: do not blend archive rates into live probability; priors only

evidence.caveat: L121 denominators not interchangeable with live

selection_cues.claim: Control closed sells: 3 still in buy set, 26 left buy set (n=29)
selection_cues.why_matters: Separates timing-ish exits (still buy-tier) from selection/thesis exits without sealing N205
selection_cues.falsify_or_promote: Thicken skeleton → sealed N205 selection lever only after design review; no capital promote from this feed

selection_cues.why_matters: Crude well/poorly split for experiment backlog triage
selection_cues.falsify_or_promote: Replace with fair-cost episode % + peer rank when N205 seals

control_closed_sells.note: Realized % is price vs avg_cost_at_exit on control closed sells — not a sealed selection scoreboard (N205 stays not_now)
